_what: NUMBERS read by a person on the remake capture 'Shrine of Plains - 17.01' (third-party material: only these numbers are in the repo, never pixels). Valid area = the capture without the player bar: 1235 x 622 px (the bar starts at y 623). Units: H = the height of the leader in px at its own feet (about 72 px; its feet are hidden by the hero behind it, +-4 px); fractions of the valid area. Eye + a 100 px grid on 1.8-4x crops: about +-5 px, the dirt edges in shadow +-30 px. A reading, not a measurement of the game.

hero.note: the leader = the top one of the column (blue pack); the other two walk behind it, nearer the camera (80 and 88 px)

route.note: the left edge is in the shadow of the bush (x 330-345 +-30 px); 2.5 H if the shadowed part is not counted
two branches around the island of grass: left x 225-340 (1.6 H), right x 545-600 (0.8 H)
the path runs almost horizontally here (x 60-310, y 250-300): the row cuts it lengthwise; its thickness on screen is about 50 px (0.7 H)

P.note: the boulder and the jar on the grass at the bottom right; nothing cuts an edge

blockedShare.note: no cliff or plateau in sight; the only wall is the dark earth bank (about 2.4 % of the frame)
